project.name: openevt-plugins
project.description: A Rust dynamic plugin crate for openevt that turns video frames into simulated event-camera CD events and exposes them through the openevt device-plugin ABI.

nodes.name: Plugin Cargo manifest
nodes.summary: Defines the openevt-plugins package, cdylib/rlib outputs, FFmpeg and serialization dependencies, and the path dependency on the parent openevt crate.

nodes.name: openevt workspace manifest
nodes.summary: Parent workspace and openevt crate manifest. It defines the host ABI, feature flags, and shared types consumed by this plugin.

nodes.name: openevt README
nodes.summary: Documents the parent crate’s HAL, plugin runtime flow, OPENEVT_PLUGIN_PATH discovery, and plugin development model.

nodes.name: Plugin library root
nodes.summary: Crate root that publicly exposes the simulator module.

nodes.name: Simulator module
nodes.summary: Module boundary exporting simulator error, plugin adapter, and numerical solver components.

nodes.name: Simulator errors
nodes.summary: Defines SimError conversions for I/O, TOML, FFmpeg, and invalid simulator configuration failures.

nodes.name: EVS numerical solver
nodes.summary: Implements the stateful event-vision-sensor model: parameter validation, deterministic noise, Forward-Euler integration, and ON/OFF event generation.

nodes.name: Video simulator plugin adapter
nodes.summary: Loads and decodes video with FFmpeg, converts frames to photocurrents, feeds the solver, and exposes discovery, geometry, streaming, and event-subscription facilities through the parent ABI.

nodes.name: EvsParameters::validate
nodes.summary: Checks finiteness, positivity, non-negativity, and timestep constraints for physical and numerical parameters.

nodes.name: EvsSimulator::process_frame_over_interval
nodes.summary: Upsamples a video frame interval into numerical timesteps and aggregates generated events.

nodes.name: step_forward_euler
nodes.summary: Runs one sensor-array Forward-Euler step, updates amplifier/noise state, and emits threshold-crossing ON/OFF events.

nodes.name: VideoSimulator::open
nodes.summary: Initializes FFmpeg, validates parameters, opens the best video stream, configures decoding and RGB scaling, and creates the EVS solver.

nodes.name: VideoSimulator::process_frame
nodes.summary: Scales a decoded frame to RGB, computes luminance photocurrents, advances the solver, and maps events to EventCD coordinates.

nodes.name: SimulatorState::advance
nodes.summary: Advances one frame batch under the shared mutex and dispatches CD and external-trigger callbacks to subscribers.

nodes.name: SimulatorDevice::open
nodes.summary: Reads plugin configuration, loads simulator parameters, opens the video backend, and creates shared simulator state.

nodes.name: SimulatorDiscovery::open_device_with_configuration
nodes.summary: Validates the raw simulator schema and constructs an ABI-erased simulator device from configuration.

nodes.name: instantiate_root_module
nodes.summary: Exports the abi_stable plugin root module with the plugin name and discovery factory.

edges.description: The crate root exposes the simulator module.
The plugin uses the parent package through a path dependency at ../.
The plugin imports openevt HAL, device-plugin ABI, and EventCD types from the parent crate.
The parent README documents plugin discovery and the simulator plugin runtime flow.
Uses FFmpeg, abi_stable, serde/TOML-backed configuration, and thiserror dependencies declared by the manifest.
Uses serde derives for simulator parameters.
Dispatches generated CD events and empty external-trigger batches to subscribed sinks.
Video RGB luminance is transformed into photocurrent frames consumed by the event-vision solver.
The solver exports EvsParameters, EvsSimulator, and generated Event values used by the adapter.

layers.name: Parent crate contract
layers.description: The workspace manifest, parent documentation, and public crate root establish how the plugin is built, discovered, and consumed.

layers.name: Event-camera simulation model
layers.description: Numerical state, physical parameters, noise model, validation, and Forward-Euler event generation.

layers.name: Video and ABI adapter
layers.description: FFmpeg video ingestion, pixel conversion, device facilities, streaming callbacks, discovery, and dynamic plugin export.

tour.title: Start with the parent contract
tour.description: Read the parent manifest and README to understand the path dependency, feature flags, plugin discovery, and ABI runtime flow.

tour.title: Understand the numerical model
tour.description: Follow EvsParameters and EvsSimulator through validation, deterministic noise, Forward-Euler integration, and ON/OFF threshold events.

tour.title: Trace video to events
tour.description: See how FFmpeg decodes frames, RGB luminance becomes photocurrent, and the solver returns EventCD coordinates and timestamps.

tour.title: Trace the streaming path
tour.description: Follow device configuration into shared simulator state, stream requests, mutex-protected frame advancement, and subscriber callbacks.

tour.title: Understand dynamic loading
tour.description: Finish at discovery and instantiate_root_module to see how the simulator becomes an abi_stable device plugin discovered by the parent crate.
